prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: Best if you want the widest engine coverage
answer_verbatim:
For a **small business**, the best *single service* depends on whether you want the **quickest check**, the **broadest tracking**, or the **best local-business focus**. If your main question is simply “Does ChatGPT recommend my business?”, **HubSpot AEO Grader** is the fastest free starting point, while **OwlSearch AI** and **Otterly.AI** are stronger if you want ongoing monitoring across ChatGPT plus other engines.[19][2][16]

A practical short list:

- **Best quick free check:** **HubSpot AEO Grader** — tracks visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity and gives an action plan.[19]
- **Best broad small-business monitoring:** **Otterly.AI** — analyzes how AI search engines mention and cite your brand.[16]
- **Best “who does ChatGPT recommend instead?” view:** **OwlSearch AI** — shows whether AI recommends your business, who it recommends instead, and why.[2]
- **Best local-business option:** **Radarkit** — specifically targets local prompts like city and “near me” searches and reports whether AI recommends your business.[10]
- **Best if you want the widest engine coverage:** **Ahrefs Brand Radar** — tracks mentions across seven engines, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and AI Overviews.[1]

If you want one recommendation, I’d choose **Otterly.AI** for most small businesses because it balances affordability, brand monitoring, and multi-engine coverage, while **HubSpot AEO Grader** is the best free first check.[16][19]

If you want, I can also give you a **2-minute decision tree** based on your budget and whether you care most about **local SEO**, **ChatGPT only**, or **multiple AI engines**.
